images.prompt: 生成一张独立原创的真实海岸旅行摄影原图，竖版3:4，1536×2048像素。高处看向一段白色石灰岩海崖，弯曲的浅褐色土路从前景草坡通向远方；一侧为翠绿草地，另一侧为青蓝海湾，天际有少量柔软白云。自然午后光，海岸线、崖壁与土路关系清楚，没有人物。只输出完整真实照片，不要文字、品牌、水印、边框、海报排版或绘画效果。

review.reason: 海岸竖幅中，白色石崖沿弧形海湾延伸，海水位于左侧，翠绿草坡与弯曲浅褐土路位于右侧；远端有天然石拱，蓝天有少量云，前景路面和崖边层次清楚，无人物和字样。

images.prompt:
Edit the supplied source photograph into Impasto Travel Miniature Poster / 厚涂旅行微景观海报. Produce one complete portrait 3:4 image, at least 1086 by 1448 pixels.
Observed source: 海岸竖幅中，白色石崖沿弧形海湾延伸，海水位于左侧，翠绿草坡与弯曲浅褐土路位于右侧；远端有天然石拱，蓝天有少量云，前景路面和崖边层次清楚，无人物和字样。
Medium: A vertical photo-and-paint poster with a source-derived miniature landscape built from raised palette-knife paint on open cream paper.
Make one portrait 3:4 sheet: the upper half presents the complete source photograph, and the lower half holds its painted miniature.
Fit the entire photograph within the upper area without distortion; allow neutral margins rather than cropping protected terrain.
Reconstruct the source coastline, cliffs, grass slopes and winding path as a small self-contained arrangement of thick oil paint.
Use visible palette-knife ridges, broken impasto edges and layered pigment; make brush direction follow the represented landforms.
Let the miniature occupy roughly half the lower panel width, floating within generous cream-paper space without a framed painting rectangle.
Sample sea blue, grassy green and cliff white from the source; preserve the major light-dark grouping while simplifying small detail.
Place the supplied short uppercase title large behind the miniature; let the paint overlap only part of the letters.
Use small coherent shadows to reveal paint thickness; keep it visibly painted rather than a plastic model or photorealistic diorama.
Omit invented landmarks, travel statistics, explanatory labels, exterior mockups and watermarks.
Preserve: Keep the upper photograph complete, with its observed scene content unchanged. In the lower miniature, preserve terrain order, coastline direction and the continuous path; simplify detail rather than substituting a generic coast. Use source-derived colors and existing landmarks only; painted relief must not imply changed real geography.
Avoid: A flat painterly filter, a full lower rectangular repaint, a toy island or glossy miniature model. Missing path, relocated coastline, invented structures, unreadable title, dense promotional copy, mockup surroundings or watermark.
Sample text supplied for this example only: {"title":"COAST"}
Return only the finished image.
Correction priority: keep the upper photograph unchanged as a complete 3:4 inset with the entire sky and foreground path visible, fitting about 44% of the canvas width centered in the upper half with broad cream margins. Keep the lower palette-knife landscape small at about 48% of canvas width centered with generous cream space; place the flat blue COAST title behind the miniature, not painted into the landscape; preserve the observed landforms and a spacious poster layout rather than an edge-to-edge painting.

review.reason: 修正版保留完整的上方海岸照片与天空、前景小路；下方以较小的调色刀厚涂微景观重现海崖、海水、草坡和弯路，蓝色 COAST 字样位于微景观后方，整体留白和上下分区符合旅行微景观海报目标。
